decisions.statement: Every `tsc` call is refused whether the call names a file or names no file.
A `tsc` call in the command word is refused whether it names a file or none.
A `bun typecheck` and a `bun run typecheck` are refused with `tsc`.
Tsc reached by a path is the same call and is refused.
Tsc reached through a runner is the same call and is refused.
A prefix that only runs the call behind that prefix does not hide a `tsc` from this hook.
A flag before the script name does not hide a `bun run typecheck`.
The repository's own `tsconfig.json` names no file.
A `tsc` run at the repository root compiles no file and exits 0.
A check reporting success over no file reads exactly like a check that passed.
A package script reaching a compiler is not read here.
A compiler under another name is refused as `tsc` under its own name is.

definition: a refusal of the typecheck calls an agent makes outside the akasha commands
